stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: Ronald Crouch tops the card with 38 pts, double chance locked away and the recliner warming up.

stories.title: Nailbiter
stories.detail: one point splits the top two - down to the wire

stories.title: No Blanks, No Blemishes
stories.detail: 2 points or better on every hole through 9 - not a blemish yet

stories.title: Three-Point Frenzy
stories.detail: 126 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - 1 off the pace

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: The Howlong Country GC contingent is represented by Shaun Tipping, and a fine job they made of it.

stories.title: Low-Marker Masterclass
stories.detail: Single-figure golf on show - 3 marker sitting 6th

stories.title: Big-Dog Territory
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: The Golf Tax
stories.detail: One good hole then one bad on holes 17 & 18 - the course charges a fee for everything

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 4 twos on the bounce on holes 15-18

stories.title: Textbook Stuff
stories.detail: 5 twos in a row on holes 14-18 - not a bad thing, actually

stories.title: Faded to Grey
stories.detail: 19 on the front, 12 on the back - flew out then ran out of legs

stories.title: Spot Fires
stories.detail: 4 3-pointers+ scattered through the round - keeps finding ways to score

stories.title: The Null Hypothesis
stories.detail: 5 twos on holes 14-18 - the scorecard is a flatline

stories.title: Rollercoaster
stories.detail: 6 threes and 4 wipes - never a dull hole

stories.title: Brilliant and Then Not
stories.detail: 4-pointer on hole 17, wipe on hole 18 - the heart rate approves

stories.title: On the Charge
stories.detail: Back-to-back 3-pointers on holes 7 & 8

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: The Scoreless Wander
stories.detail: 6 wipes from the card - cutting carbs, apparently

stories.title: Not Today, Scoreboard
stories.detail: 4 wipes from 18 holes - the scorecard is mostly fresh air

stories.title: The One-Point Buffet
stories.detail: 5 in a row on holes 16-2 - help yourself, there are plenty

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: Giveth and Taketh Away
stories.detail: 3-pointer straight into a 1-pointer on holes 17 & 18

stories.title: Two's Company
stories.detail: 3-pointers on holes 16 & 17 - this is momentum

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 10, 11 & 12 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 10, 11 & 12 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Caught at the Post
stories.detail: Held the front then got caught - 3rd

comingLast.roast: off 32 and holding the blue balls - a gallant, grinding kind of last
finished 2 clear of the blue balls - now buying Groves drinks out of gratitude
his round is over, his sweating is not - 3 above the line
in on a 3-point buffer - watching the door like everyone else
in the clubhouse, 4 points of daylight, one nervous eye on the scorers
done, 5 clear, and suddenly an expert on everyone else's back nine
in on a cushion of 5 - refreshing the board between sips
